The '''Dark Path''' was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] philosophy followed by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Vacuus]] and his followers. The adherents of the Dark Path waged war on the Sith Lord [[Pharshol]] within the [[Dark Temple]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], killing many of the early colonists. Thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of Pharshol and Vacuus, the spirits of the Dark Path adherents possessed workers and soldiers within the Dark Temple and began living out their lives once again, attacking those who were possessed by Pharshol and his followers.
